findings.text: Test entries combine a descriptive label with an internal instruction sequence, execution flags such as INTERNAL and FLAG_LARGE_MEM, expected outcome pairs and declared frame usage, with some entries using a fill helper to generate repeated update sequences rather than listing instructions directly.

Narrow memory loads from the frame pointer or from a data pointer zero extend into the wider result register, while the sign extending load variant propagates the high bit of byte, halfword and word sources into the upper bits of the result.

Partial register stores update only the addressed bytes within the surrounding cell and leave neighboring bytes unchanged, as shown by readback of the full cell after narrow stores with both clear and set high bits.

Immediate stores and register stores are exercised across all memory widths with matching loadback checks, including boundary patterns with all low bits set and with only the high bit clear, confirming round trip fidelity at a deep frame displacement.

Offset coverage includes negative displacements from an adjusted base, small and large positive displacements, and unaligned displacements, with large region cases marked for large memory handling and with endian specific displacement selection for narrow accesses near the frame top.

Atomic read modify write operations cover word and doubleword widths combined with add, bitwise and, bitwise or and bitwise exclusive or, each with and without fetch, where the memory cell holds the combined result and the fetch variant returns the prior cell value while the non fetch variant leaves the update operand observable.

Atomic templates also verify the absence of side effects on the frame pointer and on unrelated registers by comparing pointer values before and after the operation and by folding upper and lower halves of wide results into the observed outcome.

Implementations must support unaligned and large displacement memory accesses and must preserve surrounding bytes on narrow stores, since the suite treats those cases as valid rather than faults and checks exact cell contents after each operation.

Memory width names distinguish byte, halfword, word and doubleword accesses, and atomic operations distinguish fetching from non fetching forms, with endianness selecting different narrow access displacements for the same logical value.
